details: Bitmine, a prominent Ethereum treasury company, purchased an additional 9,946 ETH last week, bringing its total holdings to 5.79 million ETH, or approximately 4.8% of the circulating supply, as it approaches its 5% target. Chairman Tom Lee noted Ethereum's recent outperformance against Bitcoin and a three-month high in the ETH/BTC ratio as indicators of strengthening crypto market sentiment, projecting potential further price gains towards $2,000 and $2,500.
title: Bitmine Increases Ethereum Holdings Amid Bullish Sentiment

details: A new $15 million Bitcoin Security Consortium, supported by major players like BlackRock, Coinbase, Fidelity, Galaxy, and Strategy (MicroStrategy), has been launched. Concurrently, Galaxy introduced its $5 million Bitcoin Quantum Readiness Initiative, reflecting significant institutional efforts to safeguard Bitcoin against future quantum computing threats. Discussions around the CLARITY Act are also reportedly in their "11th hour."
title: Wall Street Firms Launch Initiatives to Quantum-Proof Bitcoin

details: LMAX, an institutional digital asset and FX marketplace based in London, is reportedly working with investment banks like Morgan Stanley and KBW to explore a NASDAQ IPO or SPAC listing, potentially valuing the company at up to $5 billion. This move highlights growing institutional interest and the maturation of crypto-related financial services.
title: Institutional Digital Asset Platform LMAX Reportedly Eyes NASDAQ IPO

details: The cryptocurrency exchange BitMart has commenced its shutdown procedures, setting a final deadline for trading. This development has led to withdrawal delays and on-chain panic among users, drawing parallels to previous challenging periods in the crypto market.
title: BitMart Begins Shutdown Process, Triggers Withdrawal Concerns

details: New York Attorney General Letitia James has voiced opposition to the proposed CLARITY Act, cautioning that its passage could "dilute" states' authority to pursue fraud cases. Her comments come amidst increasing pressure for the regulatory bill to be passed by Congress.
title: NY Attorney General Opposes CLARITY Act, Citing Fraud Concerns

details: Bitwise reports that despite recent declines in token prices, the Ethereum, Solana, and Avalanche blockchain networks are experiencing increased activity and lower transaction costs. This suggests underlying fundamental growth and efficiency improvements within these ecosystems.
title: Ethereum, Solana, and Avalanche Networks Show Growth Despite Price Dips

details: Securitize has successfully expanded its regulated offerings by securing an SEC adviser license. This development positions the company to provide a broader range of compliant services within the digital asset securities market.
title: Securitize Obtains SEC Adviser License, Expands Regulated Platform

details: Strategy (MicroStrategy) has extended its pause on Bitcoin accumulation for five weeks and sold $544.5 million in MSTR, increasing its USD reserve to $3.75 billion. This indicates a cautious approach to further BTC investment and a focus on building cash reserves.
title: Strategy (MicroStrategy) Pauses Bitcoin Accumulation, Sells MSTR
